settings.headline: Book the
settings.subtitle: We play clubs, theatres, festivals and benefits across the Southeast, and travel further for the right room. Here's what to expect, and how to reach us.

facts.title: Two sets, three hours
facts.text: Our standard night is two sets with a short break, about three hours of music. One long festival set or three New Year's-style sets work too.

facts.title: Self-sufficient
facts.text: We can bring our own sound engineer and a modest light rig, or plug into the house system. A stage plot and input list come with every confirmed date.

facts.title: A crowd that travels
facts.text: A lot of our audience follows us from town to town. Rooms from 250 to 1,500 people work best, and we promote every show to our mailing list.

includes.text: Sound engineer on request, plus a liquid light show for bigger rooms
Promotion to our mailing list and socials, with a printable poster for every show
A taper section, if the venue allows it
A fresh setlist every night, and song requests for private events

rooms.name: Riverside Stage at Jean Webb Park

settings.note: We're a fan-run tribute and not affiliated with the Grateful Dead or its members. We handle fees and contracts by email once a date is confirmed; nothing is paid through this site.

settings.headline: Tell us about the night
settings.intro: The more you can tell us about the room and the crowd, the faster we can say yes. Fields with * are needed.
settings.aside: Write to booking@example.com. For press, interviews and taping questions, use hello@example.com.

steps.title: We read it
steps.text: Your inquiry goes straight to the band and stays private.

steps.title: We check the calendar
steps.text: We reply within three working days with availability.

steps.title: We sort the details
steps.text: Fees, stage plot and hospitality are agreed by email before anything is announced.
